newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine oil production down by 68.33 percent.
newsitem.headline: Philippine oil production down by 68.33 percent.

text.p: Philippine oil production fell by 68.33 percent in the first eight months of 1996 to 226,126 barrels from 714,095 in the same period last year, the Department of Energy (DOE) said on Thursday.
The department said in a report that natural gas production rose by 56.43 percent to 209.38 million cubic feet of gas from last year's 133.85 million cubic feet.
The increase was a result of higher yields from Philippine National Oil Co-Exploration Corp's San Antonio field in Isabela, the country's lone commercial gas field.
Oil output fell after production was halted in February at West Linapacan, the country's biggest oil field.
